deep_analysis:
1 open trade: ARB LONG +2.95% (2.2h, pump-chain+, meta_rsi 61.5). Thesis intact — entry was mid-band momentum long, now profit-locked: stop 0.18404 is +2.58% above entry 0.17941, TP 0.18851 (+5.1%). If opened fresh today it passes the only regime test that matters right now (15m bounce). Hold; if it reaches +5% let the profit-monster trail take over. No other exposure — 5 of 6 slots free, which is fine because the regime is in an ambiguous transition (see regime_context).

The last 24h book (n=41 closed, 14W/23L, net ~-0.5 USDT) is a clean split: SHORTs 8/17 (47%) net positive, LONGs 6/20 (30%) net negative. Every long loss was someone else's short win. The worst entries were counter-trend chases at RSI extremes — SEI long at meta_rsi 84.2 (-0.23, single biggest loss), POL long at 85.0 (-0.07), RESOLV long at 80.0 (-0.04) — all during the bear leg. The winning side was shorting exactly those pops: volume-buildup- shorts hit ETC +6.1% (RSI 73.3), LTC +4.9% (65.2), POL +4.8% (55.8). Same coins, opposite side.

Second pattern: 9/41 closes were hard_max_loss (-0.76 total) — entries that never even armed the trail, the historical chop signature (52/56 never reached +0.40%). 7 of 9 were LONGs (ETC/MON/POL/WLFI/USUAL/BABY/HBAR), including MON knife-catch at RSI 25.2. Chop entries, wrong side, no management error — the entry was the error.

Third pattern: mid-band shorts are ALSO losers. pump-chain- shorts entered at RSI 48-51 (ETH, CAKE, HBAR, ALGO) all died to atr_sl_hit, while the same signal won when entered at extremes (ACE +7.2% at RSI 40.5, CC +1.8% at 35.3, FIL +2.7% at 44.9). The edge in shorts is at the edges, not the middle.

Note the regime flipped under us this hour: trend_quality went STRONG_DOWN to STRONG_UP, zscore NEG to POS, acceleration POSITIVE, and the 5m scanner now shows 89 LONG_BIAS / 0 SHORT across 119 tokens. The bounce is real but BTC is still below EMA300 with 4h SHORT_BIAS — unconfirmed reversal, not a new bull.
regime_context:
BTC 81,982 sits BELOW its 1m EMA300 (82,322) for 581 consecutive minutes (~9.7h) with continuum BELOW and 4h regime SHORT_BIAS — the higher-timeframe downtrend is intact. But every short-horizon gauge has flipped: zscore POS tier, acceleration POSITIVE, linreg LEAN_BULL on 1m/5m/15m, trend_quality STRONG_UP, market_phase DECLINING (recovery within decline). The 5m regime scanner reads 89 long-bias vs 0 short-bias tokens — alts are ripping.

This is a bounce inside a bear, and it decides the next hour: if BTC reclaims and holds EMA300 ~82,322, the 4h will follow and longs become the only side; if it rejects here, shorts at RSI extremes (55-73 strength pops) resume their edge. Until then the gates are correctly split — LONGs blocked by the BTC-below-EMA300 trend filter (FOGO precheck fails only that gate), SHORTS pass but only at mediocre R:R. ARB long is tolerable precisely because its stop already locks +2.58%: the bounce either carries it to TP or costs nothing.

1. Counter-trend LONG chases at RSI extremes (n=3): SEI long meta_rsi 84.2 -> -0.23 (5.2%), POL long 85.0 -> -0.07, RESOLV long 80.0 -> -0.04. WINNING side: SHORT the pop. volume-buildup- shorts on the same tape: ETC +0.14 (6.1%, RSI 73.3), LTC +0.11 (4.9%, 65.2), POL +0.11 (4.8%, 55.8). We bought their exit liquidity; we should have been their exit.

2. hard_max_loss chop entries (n=9, -0.76 total, 7/9 LONG): ETC 54.6, MON 25.2, POL 85.0, WLFI 50.0, USUAL 69.2, BABY 68.8, HBAR 58.3 longs; PUMP 50.0, CRV 50.0 shorts. 3. Mid-band shorts lose, edge-band shorts win (pump-chain-): LOSSES at RSI 48-51: ETH -0.05, CAKE -0.05, HBAR -0.02, ALGO -0.03 (all atr_sl_hit). WINS at RSI 35-45: ACE +0.30 (7.2%), CC +0.07, FIL +0.06. Same signal, same direction — the only differentiator is where in the band the entry sat. Shorting at RSI 50 in a chop = coin flip with fees.

4. Volume-buildup family confirms trend-alignment is the whole edge: volume-buildup- (SHORT) 4/4 +0.41; volume-buildup+ (LONG) 0/3 -0.26, all hard_max_loss. Identical detector, opposite result depending on trend side.
